caseName: Power Authority of New York v. Tuscarora Indian Nation

opinions.text: Certiorari, 360 U. S' 915, to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. The motion to advance is granted and this case, together with the companion case of No. 63, is set for argument on Monday, December 7, • 1959.
